## What's changed

- Fixed the native macOS package to include FFmpeg libraries referenced through loader-relative paths, including `libsharpyuv`.
- Stabilized `ffmpeg-full` setup on the persistent macOS release runner by reusing a working installation and repairing stale Homebrew links when installation is needed.
- Made manually retried releases build and test the requested release tag.

These are server-side updates; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
